fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Fourteen phishing reports collapse into one incident

Employees forward suspicious mail to a report address. When 14 reports of the same fake invoice land within 20 minutes, the app files them under INC-2291 and checks the sender domain against your threat feed. Dana Okafor on the security desk gets one request: purge the message from every inbox.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Sessions stay open until an analyst approves

Your identity provider flags a sign-in for Ben Carter from Lisbon, 38 minutes after his last one from Denver. The app pulls his 10 most recent sign-ins. Leah Novak, the analyst on call, gets a direct message with one button: revoke his sessions and require a new password. Nothing changes until she clicks.
